Name: Super Shed
Author: BurninWeeknd
Description:
Shed upgrades are as follows:

- Large shed - 23 x 21
- Huge shed - 29 x 26
- Massive shed - 31 x 27 (This tier allows casks)

Follows vanilla progression, big shed is required before large shed, so on and so forth.
